content: BullMQ OSS rate limiting (worker.rateLimit()/limiter option) is global-per-worker, not per-group/per-tenant -- group-key rate limiting was removed from OSS in v3+ and lives only in BullMQ Pro. No OSS-native per-tenant fairness mechanism exists; the standard workaround is an application-level Redis-backed limiter/semaphore keyed by tenant, checked inside the job processor before doing tenant-scoped work, combined with moveToDelayed to defer over-cap jobs without consuming BullMQ attempts.
